assetScope: explicit Shanghai/Shenzhen stock, ETF or exchange index; one symbol
dataSource: Eastmoney trends2/get; ndays 1..5, explicit secid; no provider fallback

request.dates: optional comma-separated YYYY-MM-DD, restricted to returned sessions

outputs: native multi-intraday HTML with one card per actual trading date; JSON receipt preserves coverage
cachePolicy: no server memory/disk market-data cache; only explicitly requested report artifacts
unsupported: arbitrary historical dates outside recent five sessions
